title: Storm restoration inbound call
web_intro: You're the agent. A homeowner is calling after a storm damaged their roof. You'll hear 5 situations. Answer each one out loud, in English, like a real call (20–60 seconds).
wa_intro:
I'll be a *homeowner* calling after a storm. You are the agent.

Answer each message with a *VOICE NOTE* in English, like you're on the phone (30–60 sec). There are *5 rounds*. Be warm, take control and try to *book a free roof inspection*.

Ready? Here's the call 📞

rounds.say: Hi... uh, I saw your number online. My roof started leaking last night after the storm and there's water coming through the ceiling. Who am I talking to?
rounds.goal: Open: greet + company + empathy + take control (name, address)
rubric: \b(sorry|understand|i hear you|no worries|don'?t worry|we('| a)re here|that sounds)\b
\b(your name|who am i speaking|may i have|can i get your name)\b

rounds.say: Okay but how much is this going to cost me? I really don't have money for a new roof right now.
rounds.goal: Price objection: free inspection + insurance usually covers + book

rounds.say: My insurance company already said they're sending their own adjuster. Why would I need you guys?
rounds.goal: Adjuster objection: we work WITH insurance, document everything, protect the homeowner

rounds.say: Hmm, I need to talk to my husband first before anyone comes to the house.
rounds.goal: Spouse objection: invite both, offer a time when both are home, lock it in

rounds.say: Look, I'm really busy right now. Can you just email me something and I'll look at it later?
rounds.goal: Brush-off: keep control, 30-second value, confirm address + time now, then send confirmation
rubric: \b(confirm|real quick|before (you go|i let you go)|just need|address|best (time|number))\b
